Comments: NIBSS (Nigeria Inter-Bank Settlement System) underpins national payments infrastructure and became first payment system in Africa at mature inclusivity level (AfricaNenda, Nov 2025). Officials describe payments as one of two already-established DPI rails, with data exchange the remaining piece. Value Code 4 (Partially integrated) confirmed with a second corroborating source.

Comments: Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 sets legal standards for data collection, processing, and sharing. Nigeria Data Protection Regulation (NDPR) 2019 preceded it. IT Act (2007) provides ICT governance. However, ICTD notes NDPR does not adequately address data sharing between merchant payment systems and tax administration, indicating gaps.

revision_notes: Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (verified via official text and NDPC's own site) establishes the Commission with enforcement powers (Part X) and inter-agency cooperation duties (s.5(h)), confirming primary legislation for cross-government data sharing exists. ICTD's noted sector-specific gaps (tax/merchant payments) are implementation gaps, not an absence of law. Value Code 3 (Yes) confirmed; comment and code are consistent.
